## Summary

Adds the cookbook page for [Recursive Flint](https://huggingface.co/RecursiveSI/flint), a 40B MoE open-weight model for fast, local agentic coding (Apache 2.0).

- `docs/cookbook/autoregressive/Recursive/Flint.mdx`: new page with deploy widget, model introduction, and reasoning / tool-calling examples.
- `docs/src/snippets/configs/RecursiveSI/flint.jsx`: deploy config. The widget shows only the hardware row. H200 / B200 / B300 / GB300 run the single-GPU recipe on `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-flint`. The Playground is not included.
- `docs/docs.json` + `docs/cookbook/autoregressive/intro.mdx`: new **Recursive** nav group and landing card.
- `docs/cards/logos/recursive.png`: icon-only 940×525 transparent card logo, rasterized from the official mark on recursive.com.

## Notes for reviewers

- The engine renders nothing when `matchDims` is empty. The config therefore keeps one hidden `variant` dim (`showWhen: () => false`) instead of changing `_deployment.jsx`.
- The bind host defaults to `0.0.0.0` so the Docker `-p 30000:30000` mapping reaches the server.

## TODO before publishing

- [x] DGX Spark: placeholder entry (unverified, `// TODO`) until its launch command is ready.
- [x] Paste real server output into the two `Example Output` blocks (§2.1, §2.2).

## Validation

- `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs`: OK
- `mint broken-links`: no broken links
- `mint validate`: only the 2 warnings about `popular-models.jsx` that were already there, from files this PR does not touch
- `mint dev`: the page renders the hardware row and command panel (Python / Docker, cURL) and no Playground link. The Recursive card shows on the landing page.

@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@ +--- +title: Flint +description: "Deploy Recursive's Flint with SGLang — a 40B Mixture-of-Experts model for fast, local agentic coding with a 262K context window — on NVIDIA H200, B200, B300, GB300, and DGX Spark." +tag: NEW +--- + +## Deployment + + + + + +Flint runs on the `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-flint` Docker image: + +```bash Command +docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:dev-flint +``` + +For how to launch the image, see [Install → Method 3: Using Docker](../../../docs/get-started/install#method-3-using-docker). The **Docker** toggle in the command panel below produces the full `docker run` command; the **Python** toggle produces the inner `sglang serve ...` to run inside the container. + + + +Pick your hardware to generate the launch command. + +import { Deployment } from "/src/snippets/_deployment.jsx"; +import { config } from "/src/snippets/configs/RecursiveSI/flint.jsx"; + + + +## 1. Model Introduction + +**[Flint](https://huggingface.co/RecursiveSI/flint)** is a new open-weight **40B Mixture-of-Experts** model from Recursive, built for fast, local AI coding. Flint was developed using Recursive's Eureka Machine for automated AI research and is released under Apache 2.0. + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
ModelTotal paramsContextUse
Flint40B (MoE)262,144Fast, local agentic coding
+ +**License:** Apache 2.0 + +**Resources:** [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/RecursiveSI/flint). + +## 2. Advanced Usage + +### 2.1 Reasoning + +Launch with `--reasoning-parser flint` (included in the commands above). Thinking is separated into `message.reasoning_content`, and the final answer is returned in `message.content`. + + + +```python Example +from openai import OpenAI + +client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:30000/v1", api_key="EMPTY") + +response = client.chat.completions.create( + model="flint", + messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is 15% of 240?"}], +) + +message = response.choices[0].message +print("=============== Reasoning ===============") +print(message.reasoning_content) +print("=============== Answer ===============") +print(message.content) +``` + + + + + +```text Output +=============== Reasoning =============== +We need answer simple. Need maybe show calculation. User asks "What is 15% of 240?" We can answer. Need be careful maybe just 36. Let's craft concise. +=============== Answer =============== +15% of 240 is **36**. +``` + + + +### 2.2 Tool Calling + +Launch with `--tool-call-parser flint` (included in the commands above) to surface structured tool calls via `message.tool_calls`. + + + +```python Example +import json +from openai import OpenAI + +client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:30000/v1", api_key="EMPTY") + +tools = [ + { + "type": "function", + "function": { + "name": "get_weather", + "description": "Get the current weather for a city", + "parameters": { + "type": "object", + "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}}, + "required": ["city"], + }, + }, + } +] + +response = client.chat.completions.create( + model="flint", + messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What's the weather in Paris?"}], + tools=tools, +) + +message = response.choices[0].message +print("=============== Reasoning ===============") +print(getattr(message, "reasoning_content", None)) +print("=============== Content ===============") +print(message.content) +print("=============== Tool Calls ===============") +for call in message.tool_calls or []: + print(call.function.name, json.loads(call.function.arguments)) +``` + + + + + +```text Output +=============== Reasoning =============== +The user asked for the weather in Paris, and I have a get_weather tool available that takes a city parameter. I should call it with city 'Paris' to get the current weather. +=============== Content =============== +I'll get the current weather for Paris for you. +=============== Tool Calls =============== +get_weather {'city': 'Paris'} +``` + +

@@ -0,0 +1,153 @@
+export const config = {
+  modelName: "Flint",
+
+  supportedHardware: ["h200", "b200", "b300", "gb300", "dgx-spark"],
+
+  // A single hidden dim: the engine renders nothing when matchDims is empty.
+  matchDims: [
+    { id: "variant", title: "Model Variant", showWhen: () => false, options: [{ id: "default", label: "Default" }] },
+  ],
+
+  modelNames: {
+    default: "RecursiveSI/flint",
+  },
+
+  placeholders: {
+    HOST_IP:   { target: "command", label: "Bind host",         default: "0.0.0.0"         },
+    PORT:      { target: "command", label: "Bind port",         default: "30000"           },
+    HF_TOKEN:  { target: "command", label: "HF token (Docker)", default: "<your-hf-token>" },
+    CURL_HOST: { target: "curl",    label: "Server host",       default: "localhost"       },
+    CURL_PORT: { target: "curl",    label: "Server port",       default: "30000"           },
+  },
+
+  curl: `curl http://{{CURL_HOST}}:{{CURL_PORT}}/v1/chat/completions \\
+-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
+-d '{ "model": "flint", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}] }'`,
+
+  showPlaygroundLink: false,
+
+  dockerImages: {
+    h200:        "lmsysorg/sglang:dev-flint",
+    b200:        "lmsysorg/sglang:dev-flint",
+    b300:        "lmsysorg/sglang:dev-flint",
+    gb300:       "lmsysorg/sglang:dev-flint",
+    "dgx-spark": "lmsysorg/sglang:dev-flint",
+  },
+
+  github: {
+    cookbookModel: "RecursiveSI/flint",
+  },
+
+  cells: [
+    {
+      match: { hw: "h200", variant: "default" },
+      verified: true,
+      nnodes: 1,
+      env: [],
+      // No backend flags: FA4 and the trtllm MoE are Blackwell-only, and on Hopper Flint resolves to FA3 and Triton MoE.
+      flags: [
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--served-model-name flint",
+        "--tp-size 1",
+        "--enable-fp32-lm-head",
+        "--context-length 262144",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size 4096",
+        "--enable-unified-memory",
+        "--mem-fraction-static 0.8",
+        "--tool-call-parser flint",
+        "--reasoning-parser flint",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
+    {
+      match: { hw: "b200", variant: "default" },
+      verified: true,
+      nnodes: 1,
+      env: [],
+      flags: [
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--served-model-name flint",
+        "--tp-size 1",
+        "--attention-backend fa4",
+        "--moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm_routed",
+        "--enable-fp32-lm-head",
+        "--context-length 262144",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size 4096",
+        "--swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.05",
+        "--mem-fraction-static 0.8",
+        "--tool-call-parser flint",
+        "--reasoning-parser flint",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
+    {
+      match: { hw: "b300", variant: "default" },
+      verified: true,
+      nnodes: 1,
+      env: [],
+      flags: [
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--served-model-name flint",
+        "--tp-size 1",
+        "--attention-backend fa4",
+        "--moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm_routed",
+        "--enable-fp32-lm-head",
+        "--context-length 262144",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size 4096",
+        "--swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.05",
+        "--mem-fraction-static 0.8",
+        "--tool-call-parser flint",
+        "--reasoning-parser flint",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
+    {
+      match: { hw: "gb300", variant: "default" },
+      verified: true,
+      nnodes: 1,
+      env: [],
+      flags: [
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--served-model-name flint",
+        "--tp-size 1",
+        "--attention-backend fa4",
+        "--moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm_routed",
+        "--enable-fp32-lm-head",
+        "--context-length 262144",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size 4096",
+        "--swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.05",
+        "--mem-fraction-static 0.8",
+        "--tool-call-parser flint",
+        "--reasoning-parser flint",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
+    {
+      match: { hw: "dgx-spark", variant: "default" },
+      verified: true,
+      nnodes: 1,
+      env: [],
+      // No backend flags: on GB10 Flint resolves to Triton attention and Triton MoE.
+      // GB10 counts page cache as used GPU memory, so evict each weight shard after loading it.
+      flags: [
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--served-model-name flint",
+        "--tp-size 1",
+        "--enable-fp32-lm-head",
+        "--context-length 262144",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size 4096",
+        "--enable-unified-memory",
+        "--mem-fraction-static 0.8",
+        "--weight-loader-drop-cache-after-load",
+        "--tool-call-parser flint",
+        "--reasoning-parser flint",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
+  ],
+};
